headings.note: Use Cormorant Garamond for all H1, H2, H3 to provide an elegant, high-end gastronomy feel. Never use Inter for headings.

body.note: Outfit provides a clean, modern geometric sans contrast to the highly stylized serif.

labels_overlines.note: Use for section markers (e.g., 'ABOUT US', 'OUR MENU').

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffused shadows only. Example: shadow-[0_12px_40px_rgba(26,32,25,0.06)]. Avoid harsh offset shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-[#7C9070]/15 for grid lines or subtle dividers.
visual_enhancers.effects: Crystal Glassmorphism for the sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FBFBF9]/70 border-b border-[#7C9070]/10). Saturate background to 150%.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a fixed, pointer-events-none SVG noise overlay across the entire site with opacity 2% to give a tactile, paper-like editorial feel.

layouts.hero: 100vh height. Full viewport width image with a subtle gradient overlay (black/40 to transparent) for text legibility. Large centered Serif typography. Prominent 'Call to Reserve' button. Floating chevron-down indicator.
layouts.about: Asymmetrical structure. Image offset to the left, text block on the right with heavy padding (p-12 to p-24). Never center align the paragraph here.
layouts.menu_section: Generous spacing (py-32). Incorporate a sleek embedded PDF viewer or a high-res menu image with 'react-zoom-pan-pinch' for zoom capabilities. Background should be secondary beige (#EFECE5).
layouts.gallery: Bento Grid Protocol Mode A (Tetris Grid). gap-6 to gap-8. Mix of landscape and portrait images. span 2 columns and 2 rows to create tension.
layouts.contact: 2-column layout on md+. Left column: elegant typography for address, hours (10h-midnight, closed Sundays), and phone (01 70 59 49 87). Right column: Mapbox/Google Maps iframe with a grayscale filter (CSS filter: grayscale(100%) contrast(120%)).
layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more padding than usual (e.g., py-24, gap-12). Container max-width should be max-w-7xl with px-6.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp rectangle based on preference, but pill-shaped suits the soft sage vibe better. Primary CTA: bg-[#7C9070] text-white hover:bg-[#637359] px-8 py-3. Must include hover micro-interactions (subtle scale down or icon slide).
components.language_switcher: Fixed in the navigation bar. Simple text toggle 'FR | EN' with the active language bolded and slightly larger. Ensure state manages translation mapping.
components.nav_bar: Sticky to top, transparent at first, turns to Crystal Glass on scroll. Logo (BHV) on left, links center, phone CTA right.
components.mobile_call_fab: Visible only on mobile (block md:hidden). Fixed at bottom-right, pulsing sage green circle with a Phone icon to drive phone reservations.

motion.scroll: MANDATORY: implement '@studio-freight/lenis' for smooth scrolling to provide premium momentum.
motion.entrance: Use 'framer-motion' for staggered reveal (fade up and subtle translate-y) for text and images when they enter the viewport.
motion.hover: Images inside the gallery should scale to 105% over 700ms ease-out on hover. Buttons should have color shifts.

images.description: Luxurious dining room for hero background (darken with overlay)
Elegant restaurant tables set with flowers and wine glasses
Elegant plated steak dish garnished with microgreens
Gourmet salmon dish served with couscous

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-reserve-btn').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images uses proper overlays or text-shadows. Check sage green text against bone white background.
accessibility.motion: Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion' by avoiding heavy parallax for users who have it enabled.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI strictly using React and Tailwind CSS. Do not use generic Shadcn components for the marketing page layout except where complex accessibility is needed (like Dialogs).
Install and setup @studio-freight/lenis for the entire app smooth scrolling.
Install framer-motion for all scroll entrance animations and hover states.
Add 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' fonts via Google Fonts in index.html and configure them in tailwind.config.js.
Implement the bilingual requirement using a simple React Context or local state with a dictionary object (FR/EN) wrapping the text elements.

For the PDF Menu Viewer, either implement an iframe pointing to a local static PDF file or use a lightweight viewer like react-pdf. Include zoom capabilities. If no PDF is available, implement a fallback high-res image with zoom (e.g., react-zoom-pan-pinch).
For the Google Maps integration, use an iframe embedded map of '60 Av. de la Division Leclerc, 93350 Le Bourget, France' with CSS filter 'grayscale(100%)' to match the elegant branding.
Implement a Mobile Call FAB (Floating Action Button) that is hidden on 'md' screens and above, fixed to the bottom right with a pulsating effect to encourage reservations.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Components MUST use named exports. Pages MUST use default exports.
